name: New Adventure
source:
New Adventure, You are a young man who has been unhappy with his life since childhood, and decide it's time for a new life, a "New Adventure" in which you decide to start over with a new job in a new town, from here things take an interesting turn, you meet many friendly females, who may or may not become close with you, you soon find there is a hidden side to this new town.

Soon you realise things don't seem as they first appeared, they're starting to become stranger and stranger. Only time will tell what this all means and what all these changes of your new life are to become.
translation:
在《New Adventure》中，你是一名从小就对生活感到不满的年轻男子。如今，你决定开启新的人生，踏上一场“新的冒险”：搬到新的小镇，换份新的工作，从头开始。此后，事情出现了有趣的转折。你结识了许多友善的女性，彼此或许会发展出亲密关系，也或许不会。很快，你便发现这座小镇还有不为人知的一面。

你逐渐意识到，事情并不像最初看起来的那样，而且正变得越来越古怪。这一切究竟意味着什么，新生活中的种种变化又将走向何方，只有时间才能给出答案。
